To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) The pictogram comprehension of agricultural workers is low, with the exception of the pictogram of the tractor; (b) The pictogram of the forage harvester has the lowest comprehension rate; (c) The comprehension rate is higher for pictograms affixed in the operator's field of view than for those affixed on the machine; and (d) There are differences between the pictogram comprehension of the different groups of agricultural workers, with the lowest rates found in the group
(1) the pictograms are not understood by a majority of users, and (2) the pictograms do not meet the requirements of the ANSI standard for safety symbols.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the comprehension of pictograms by agricultural machinery users.
how the pictorial symbols used on the labels of agricultural machinery are understood by the operators.
how the pictogram is perceived and interpreted by users of agricultural machinery, and the effect this has on the safety of the machine and the operator.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pictorial symbols used in this study were not effective at communicating a message to users of agricultural machinery.

the majority of users of agricultural machinery are able to comprehend the pictograms affixed, however, there is a need to ensure that the pictograms are affixed in a clear, legible manner and are not obscured by dirt, dust or mud.
the safety signs used on agricultural machinery are effective in conveying the intended message to the operator.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach for assessing the comprehension of safety pictograms by users of agricultural machinery.
we have shown that the pictograms used in the EU to warn users about the dangers of using agricultural machinery are generally well understood.
the majority of the participants were able to correctly identify the meaning of all pictograms, but that there were some differences in the way that participants interpreted some of the pictograms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pictograms are not always understood in the same way.
pictograms can be a useful and effective means of conveying safety information to users of machinery.
the use of pictorial symbols is a promising approach to improving the comprehension of safety information.
